title: Across Dimension
description: A lightweight Fabric mod that enables interdimensional teleportation via Ender pearl stasis chambers in Minecraft 1.17.1.
body:
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/MtIRmg6FcT8" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe># Interdimensional Pearls

Hey! This is a simple and lightweight Fabric mod for Minecraft 1.17.1 that fixes a pretty annoying vanilla issue: Ender pearl stasis chambers don't work if you cross dimensions.

If you are playing in a technical server or a singleplayer world and you try to trigger a wireless pearl from the Overworld while being in the Nether or the End, nothing happens. This mod fixes that exact problem, allowing clean cross-dimensional teleportation.

### Features
* Server-side only (Players don't need to install it to join).
* Works perfectly in singleplayer too.

### Info
Let me know in the comments if you want this fix ported to another version!
